Action: # New Application Form: Pre-assessment Checklist
new_application_form/preassessment_checklist
## Checkbox is only shown for Mexico and Indonesia
Setup: You need a publisher account that can start a new application (use a fresh account or start a fresh draft)

Go to the application form

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Complete page 1 (Open access compliance) and click Next, or skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar. Do not touch the "Publisher's country" field yet

Expected Test Results: No pre-assessment checklist checkbox is visible below "Publisher's country"

Action: In "Publisher's country", select any country other than Mexico or Indonesia (e.g. France)

Expected Test Results: No checkbox appears

Action: Change "Publisher's country" to Mexico

Expected Test Results: A checkbox appears below the field reading: "I confirm that I have completed the pre-assessment checklist"
The "pre-assessment checklist" link goes to the Spanish-language Google Form

Action: Change "Publisher's country" to Indonesia

Expected Test Results: The checkbox is shown with the same wording
The "pre-assessment checklist" link now goes to the English-language Google Form

Action: Change "Publisher's country" back to a country that is not Mexico or Indonesia

Expected Test Results: The checkbox and its accompanying text disappear entirely

Action: ## Checklist help text and links

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Select Mexico or Indonesia in "Publisher's country"

Expected Test Results: Below the checkbox there is an explanatory paragraph beginning "We are launching a pre-assessment checklist..." and ending "...please see our blogpost"
Below that there are two separate lines: "For Mexican journals, please use the Spanish version" and "For Indonesian journals, please use the English version"
The two lines use the same font size and spacing as the paragraph above them

Action: Click the "blogpost" link

Expected Test Results: The DOAJ blog announcement post (blog.doaj.org/2026/09/28/...) opens in a new tab

Action: Click the "Spanish version" link

Expected Test Results: The Mexico (Spanish-language) checklist Google Form opens in a new tab

Action: Click the "English version" link

Expected Test Results: The Indonesia (English-language) checklist Google Form opens in a new tab

Action: Click the "pre-assessment checklist" link in the checkbox label

Expected Test Results: The checklist for the selected country opens in a new tab

Action: ## Checkbox is required to leave page 2

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Fill in all the required fields on page 2, selecting Mexico or Indonesia in "Publisher's country"
Leave the pre-assessment checklist checkbox unchecked and click Next

Expected Test Results: You are not taken to page 3
A red error message with a warning icon appears by the checkbox: "You must confirm you have completed the pre-assessment checklist before continuing"
The error looks the same as the other required-field errors on the page

Action: Tick the checkbox

Expected Test Results: The error message disappears

Action: Click Next

Expected Test Results: You are taken to page 3 (Copyright & licensing) as normal

Action: Click Back to return to page 2, then change "Publisher's country" to a country that is not Mexico or Indonesia
Click Next

Expected Test Results: You are taken to page 3 as normal; there is no checkbox and nothing blocks you

Action: ## Checkbox cannot be bypassed using the progress menu

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Fill in all the required fields on page 2, selecting Mexico or Indonesia in "Publisher's country", and leave the pre-assessment checklist checkbox unchecked
Instead of clicking Next, click on (3) in the application progress menu on the right

Expected Test Results: The checklist error message is shown by the checkbox
You are still taken to page 3, and page 2 is marked red in the progress menu

Action: Complete pages 3 to 6 and go to page 7 (Review your answers)

Expected Test Results: A red alert is shown saying that you cannot submit the application because it contains some invalid fields

Action: Check the consent box at the bottom of the page

Expected Test Results: The Submit button stays greyed out and cannot be clicked

Action: Click "Edit this section" for the About section, tick the pre-assessment checklist checkbox, and click "Review your answers" in the progress menu

Expected Test Results: The invalid-fields alert is no longer shown

Action: Check the consent box

Expected Test Results: The Submit button becomes active and the application can be submitted

Action: ## Checkbox resets when the country is changed

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Select Mexico in "Publisher's country" and tick the checkbox
Change "Publisher's country" to Indonesia

Expected Test Results: The checkbox is shown again, unchecked (the tick for Mexico is not carried over)

Action: Tick the checkbox again, then change "Publisher's country" to a country that is not Mexico or Indonesia

Expected Test Results: The checkbox disappears

Action: Change "Publisher's country" back to Mexico

Expected Test Results: The checkbox is shown again, unchecked

Action: ## Checkbox is shown when returning to a saved draft

Go to the application form, skip to page 2 (About) using the progress bar

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply
Fill in the journal title, select Mexico in "Publisher's country" and leave the checkbox unchecked
Save the application as a draft
Go to your publisher dashboard and re-open the draft application
Go to page 2 (About)

Expected Test Results: Mexico is selected in "Publisher's country"
The pre-assessment checklist checkbox is already shown, unchecked, without having to change the country

Action: Tick the checkbox, then save the application as a draft again
Re-open the draft from your publisher dashboard and go to page 2 (About)

Expected Test Results: The checkbox is shown but is unchecked again. This is expected - the tick is not saved with the draft, so the applicant must confirm again before continuing.

Action: Click Next without ticking the checkbox

Expected Test Results: You are not taken to page 3 and the checklist error message is shown

Action: ## Checkbox does not appear on the editorial application form
Find an existing application whose publisher's country is Mexico or Indonesia (or set one on any application), and open it for review/edit

Expected Test Results: No pre-assessment checklist checkbox appears below "Publisher's country"

Action: Change "Publisher's country" between Mexico, Indonesia and another country

Expected Test Results: The checkbox never appears, regardless of the country selected

Action: Repeat the above as an editor or associate editor on an application assigned to you

Expected Test Results: The checkbox never appears

Action: ## Checkbox does not appear on the journal form
Find a journal in DOAJ whose publisher's country is Mexico or Indonesia (or set one on any journal), and open it for editing

Expected Test Results: No pre-assessment checklist checkbox appears below "Publisher's country"

Action: Change "Publisher's country" between Mexico, Indonesia and another country

Expected Test Results: The checkbox never appears, regardless of the country selected

Action: Click "SAVE"

Expected Test Results: The journal saves without being blocked by any checklist validation

Action: ## Checkbox does not appear on the update request form
Setup: You need a publisher account which owns a journal in DOAJ whose publisher's country is Mexico or Indonesia
Go to your publisher dashboard and start an update request for that journal
Go to the "Publisher's country" field

Expected Test Results: No pre-assessment checklist checkbox appears, even though the country is Mexico or Indonesia

Action: Change "Publisher's country" to the other of Mexico/Indonesia

Expected Test Results: The checkbox still does not appear

Action: ## Checkbox state is not saved with the application

Go to the application form and complete and submit an application with Mexico or Indonesia as "Publisher's country", ticking the pre-assessment checklist checkbox when prompted

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//apply

Expected Test Results: The application submits successfully and you are shown the confirmation page

Action: As an admin, open the submitted application (or inspect the Application record in Elasticsearch)

Expected Test Results: There is no field anywhere in the application relating to the pre-assessment checklist checkbox. This is expected - the checkbox is UI-only and is not stored.

Action: Note: the checkbox requirement is enforced in the browser only. Submitting via the API, or bypassing the JavaScript validation, is not blocked by it. This is a known and accepted limitation, not a bug.
